hero.title: Where days slow
hero.body: Barefoot cottages, sea-view suites and villas on Pangasinan's quietest sand — ten minutes from the Cape Bolinao lighthouse, a world away from everything else.

booking.title: Reserve Your Sanctuary
booking.note: Instant SMS confirmation · Zero booking fees · Direct resort rates

items.title: Sunset Outrigger Sail
items.body: Glide through calm Lingayen waters on a traditional wooden bangka as the sun sets over the West Philippine Sea.

items.title: Lighthouse Lantern Walk
items.body: Evening stroll to the 1905 Cape Bolinao Lighthouse, carrying warm woven bamboo lanterns along the bluff.

items.title: Balingasay River Cruise
items.body: Gentle drift through one of Luzon's cleanest river ecosystems surrounded by lush centuries-old mangroves.

items.title: Fresh Coral Reef Snorkeling
items.body: Guided morning snorkel along the preserved giant clam sanctuaries and coral gardens of Patar reef.

items.quote: The sweetest sea breeze and warmest hospitality. Waking up fifty steps from the sand felt like our own private paradise.
items.name: Maria & Christian S.

items.quote: No noisy crowds, just pristine golden sand, grilled seafood at dusk, and stargazing from the veranda. We will return every summer.
items.name: David L.

items.quote: Our barkada loved the relaxed atmosphere and easy access to the lighthouse. The staff treats you like beloved family.
items.name: Camille R.

location.title: The Tip of Pangasinan
location.body: Perched on Patar Beach in Bolinao, Pangasinan. A scenic four-hour coastal drive north of Metro Manila, directly overlooking the open West Philippine Sea.

items.q: What time is check-in and check-out?
items.a: Check-in begins at 2:00 PM and check-out is at 12:00 PM noon. Early check-in or late check-out is accommodated whenever available.

items.q: Is the beach swimmable and child-friendly?
items.a: Yes, Patar Beach features shallow natural lagoons with gentle slope and soft golden sand, ideal for swimming and wading at low and mid tides.

items.q: Can we bring our own food or cook on site?
items.a: Our on-site seaside kitchen serves freshly prepared local seafood, breakfast, and grilled dishes. Grilling stations are also available for guests upon request.

items.q: Do you offer transportation or boat hire?
items.a: Yes, our concierge team can coordinate outrigger boat excursions to Hundred Islands and local tricycles to nearby Bolinao attractions.

items.title: Quiet Season Retreat
items.body: Enjoy 20% off three-night weekday stays booked at least 14 days in advance.

items.title: Work by the Water
items.body: Complimentary daily breakfast and high-speed workspace privileges on stays over 5 nights.

items.title: Sunset Anniversary
items.body: Includes sunset outrigger tour and candlelit grilled seafood dinner on the beach.

dining.title: Grilled Fresh at Dusk
dining.body: No stiff dining rooms. Enjoy hot garlic sinangag in the morning, grilled Dagupan bangus at midday, and fresh catch of the day by lantern light.

cta.title: Let the tide set
cta.body: Escape the city rush. Reserve direct for guaranteed lowest rates and personalized concierge care.
